dropzone.label: Drag your logo here
dropzone.hint: SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG. Up to 5 MB for an SVG, 10 MB for an image.

errors.ASSET_TOO_LARGE: This file is over the limit: logo up to 5 MB (SVG) or 10 MB and 8,192 px per side (image), document up to 2 MB. Make it smaller, then try again.
errors.ASSET_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This format is not recognised. Drop an SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG logo, or a TXT, Markdown or DOCX document.
errors.ASSET_SVG_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT: This SVG contains scripts or external links. Export it again without interactivity or linked resources.
errors.ASSET_SVG_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE: This SVG contains unconverted text or unsupported elements. Export it with text converted to outlines.
errors.ASSET_SVG_TOO_COMPLEX: This SVG is too complex. Simplify or merge its paths, then try again.
errors.ASSET_DECODE_FAILED: This file looks damaged. Export it again from your design software.
errors.ASSET_SCAN_TIMEOUT: Checking took too long. Try again in a moment.
errors.ASSET_DOCUMENT_EMPTY: This document has no usable text.
errors.ASSET_DOCUMENT_TOO_COMPLEX: This document is too large once opened. Export it as plain text or Markdown.
errors.ASSET_PDF_UNSUPPORTED: PDFs are not read yet. Export your document as DOCX, Markdown or text, or paste it in the field below.

liveText.title: This SVG contains live text.
liveText.advice: Charta keeps outlines only, so your logo looks the same everywhere. Best: export it again with text converted to outlines (Illustrator: Type › Create Outlines). Otherwise, convert it here into a high-definition image drawn with the fonts installed on this computer.
liveText.missing: Fonts missing on this computer: {fonts}. Converting here would draw a substitute font: export the SVG with text converted to outlines instead.

dropzone.labelMany: Drag your logos and brand document here
dropzone.hintMany: Logos: SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG (5 MB for an SVG, 10 MB for an image), six at most. Optional document: TXT, Markdown or DOCX, 2 MB at most.

start.title: Which brand are we dressing today?
start.lead: A name and a logo are enough. The more you tell us, the more the guidelines look like you.
start.name: Brand name
start.briefHint: Mission, audience, values, tone… Paste your brief or drop a document above: Gemini uses it to write the manifesto and tone of voice.
start.needLogo: Drop at least your primary logo.
start.darkBackground: Light logo detected: it is shown on a dark background.
start.network: The connection was interrupted. Check your network, then try again.
start.turnstile: The anti-bot check did not complete. Try again.
start.rateLimited: Too many projects created in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
start.quota: Your free plan has reached its project limit. Delete one from "My projects", or see the pricing.
start.refused: The request was refused (code {code}). Try again in a moment.
start.logoHint: The primary logo is required. Add its variants (horizontal, vertical, icon, black, white) and, if you have one, the document describing your brand.
start.briefPlaceholder: E.g.: Atelier Horizon brings the neighbourhood’s craftspeople together in a workshop open to all…
start.after: You land in the studio: the guideline builds before your eyes, page after page.
start.coverLead: The brief sets the tone of the cover.
start.coverNote: Preview: the final cover takes the colours measured in your logo.

dont.outline: Do not use as an outline

workspace.unknown: I cannot do that here yet. Try for example: “darker accent”, “primary #1F6F5C”, “another typeface”, “swap primary and accent” or, on a selected page, “portrait”.
workspace.failedReply: The change was not saved: the guideline is unchanged.
workspace.applied: Done: {change}. Undo it with the Undo button.
workspace.promptWaiting: Available once the guideline is ready…
workspace.dropLead: Charta reads your logo, extracts its palette, checks contrast and builds the guideline before your eyes.
workspace.mockupsLead: Each object is painted in a colour of your guideline, with the photograph's light kept, then receives your real file with a real finish: print, foil, emboss, embroidery. The logo is never redrawn.

insight.palette: I found {found, plural, one {# colour} other {# colours}} in your logo. The primary and the accent:
insight.fix: {role} on {against} is not readable as text:
insight.fixProposal: Same hue, lightness adjusted by the colour engine:
insight.typography: Type pairing chosen from the open catalogue (SIL OFL):
insight.review: A one-colour version needs checking: the engine had to simplify shapes. Look at the Logo page.
insight.textsBrief: The manifesto and tone of voice will be written by the AI from your brief. Meanwhile, you can write them in the inspector.
insight.textsNoBrief: Without a brief, I do not invent a manifesto: write the mission and vision in the inspector, or add a brief to the project.
insight.fromBrief: Your brief already states the mission and vision. I can carry them into the guideline as written:

inspector.label: Inspector
inspector.empty: Settings appear once the guideline is ready.
inspector.mockup: Computed mockup: the logo file is projected as it is onto the photographed surface, then shaded by the scene. Change the palette or the logo: the scene follows.
inspector.hexInvalid: Enter a code such as #E24329 or E24329.
inspector.measured: Values measured on your logo during the analysis; you can adjust them.
inspector.title: Page title
inspector.note: Every change is a saved command you can undo. Contrast is recomputed by the colour engine.

announce.ready: Guideline ready: every page can be edited.

exporting.title: Export the guideline
exporting.lead: Files are produced from the guideline as you see it.

exporting.cssDetail: Colours, scale, fonts and logo rules.

exporting.kitDetail: Colour, black, white and primary colour, as SVG and PNG from 512 to 2,048 px, with the usage rules.
